atoms.text: Identity politics and activism achieved important legal changes in the US and UK over the past century. The following legislations are important milestones in combating discrimination.
atoms.sound: Identity politics and activism achieved important legal changes in the US and UK over the past century. The following legislations are important milestones in combating discrimination.

atoms.text: The Achievement of the Civil Rights Movement

The US Civil Rights Movement fought against segregation of African Americans in the US. It aimed to secure civil rights and equal participation in society. This lead to the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed discrimination in employment, education, and ensured accessibility to voting and public spaces.
atoms.sound: The achievements of the Civil Rights Movement. The US Civil Rights Movement fought against segregation of African Americans in the US. It aimed to secure civil rights and equal participation in society. This led to the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed discrimination in employment, education, and ensured accessibility to voting and public spaces.

atoms.text: The UK Equality Act 2010 protects all minorities from discrimination by law. The act supports equal treatment and an inclusive, accessible society. It also defines a legal disability status which gives disabled people the means to advocate for themselves legally.
atoms.sound: Disability and the Equality Act. The UK Equality Act 2010 protects all minorities from discrimination by law. The act supports equal treatment and an inclusive, accessible society. It also defines a legal disability status which gives disabled people the means to advocate for themselves legally.

atoms.a: Select the correct statements regarding the Equality Act.
b: The act protects only disabled people from discrimination.
++A legal disability status is defined in the act.
Disabled people are fully integrated into society.

hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.text: Theodora had to change her general practitioner because he did not take her pain seriously. Instead, he told her, that Black women were resistant to pain. She reported him because of his racist maltreatment.

Eun-woo recently watched a series about the secret romance of two elite hockey players managing the difficult reality of homophobia in sport. As a hockey-loving Asian-Canadian he felt really represented seeing a White-Asian as one of the lead actors on the screen.

In his old age, Harry began to struggle with his memory and household tasks. First, he felt insecure about it. Now, he is happy that he told his son. They prepared his application for a disability status, so he can receive household aid and also sought out medication for dementia.
